title: Ergodicity for a Constantin-Lax-Majda-DeGregorio model of turbulent flow
summary: This paper presents a mathematical analysis of a one-dimensional model of turbulence based on a stochastic generalized Constantin-Lax-Majda-DeGregorio (gCLMG) equation. We focus on the specific case where the nonlinearity in the equation allows the existence of the anomalous enstrophy cascade, which is an inviscid conserved quantity, and some effective energy estimates for mathematical analysis.
